title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Placing Delivery & Pickup Services Orders — Speeds, Contents, Dates and Redelivery
content:
A delivery order under Delivery & Pickup Services is placed only within the limits below. Each limit reads the plan's own figures in the Delivery & Pickup Services tariff, service area schedule, handover standard and service levels.

## Rules in force

1. **Open plan.** An order is placed only on a plan in enrolled, active or past-due status, and a cancelled plan takes no orders. The status is read from the plan record.
2. **Speeds.** A speed is offered only where the plan offers it: standard mail where the plan offers standard mail; same-day where the plan offers same-day and the order is placed by the plan's same-day cutoff time; one-hour express where the plan offers express; and the temperature-controlled courier speed only on Kestrel Specialty Courier Service.
3. **Distance.** A courier order goes no farther than the plan's largest delivery distance.
4. **Contents.** An order carries a controlled-substance prescription only where the plan allows controlled substances and the prescription's class is eligible for delivery under the Prescriptions charter; a temperature-controlled item only where the plan carries temperature-controlled items; store items only where the plan includes store items.
5. **Delivery date.** The scheduled date is no more than the plan's scheduling limit in days after today and falls on one of the plan's delivery days: Monday to Friday when the plan delivers 5 days a week, every day when it delivers 7, and never a Sunday where the plan makes no Sunday deliveries.
6. **Carrier.** Orders are carried by the plan's carrier.
7. **Promised window.** The promised window of a same-day order ends at the window start plus the plan's same-day window minutes, and that of an express order at the placing time plus the plan's express minutes; a standard mail order is promised within the plan's mail transit business days of dispatch.
8. **Daily limit.** A patient places no more than the plan's daily limit of same-day and express orders per day. The orders counted are the patient's same-day and express orders scheduled for that same calendar day, cancelled orders not counted.
9. **Redelivery.** A redelivery is placed as a new order naming the failed order. A redelivery is scheduled no later than the date of the failed attempt plus the redelivery window days, counted in calendar days with the failed attempt date as day 0.

## Clause no longer in force

*"A past-due plan's orders are priced as Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery orders under the subscription billing rules."* This clause is **no longer in force**; the pricing of an order placed while its plan is past due is set by the current order-fee basis, which supersedes it. Rule 1 still admits orders on a past-due plan.

## The redelivery window

The clock starts on the date of the failed attempt, as the attempt record shows it, and that date is day 0; the last day of the window is day N, N being the plan's redelivery window days, and day N itself is within the window.

| Plan | Redelivery window | Failed attempt (day 0) | Last day of the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 2 days | 10 March | 12 March |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | 5 days | 10 March | 15 March |
| Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | 1 day | 10 March | 11 March |

Hypothetical boundary on Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly (2 days), failed attempt on 10 March: a redelivery for 12 March is within the window; one for 13 March is not.

## Hypothetical checks

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Same-day order on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery placed at 13:55 | same-day offered (cutoff 14:00) |
| Same-day order on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery placed at 14:20 | same-day not offered |
| Order with store items on Kestrel Mail Delivery | not accepted: store items are not included |
| Delivery for a Sunday on Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | not accepted: no Sunday deliveries |
| Third same-day or express order for one day on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery (limit 2) | not accepted |
| Order on a plan in cancelled status | not accepted |
